review: The probe runs only under P11_BENCHMARK=disposable-local-only inside the P01 disposable namespace as UID 1000, read-only root, no added capabilities, no published port and the P01 default-deny transport rules.

It reuses the admitted runtime file, the candidate database role candidate_runtime with navigation/checkout/P08/P09 grant checks, and refuses any database other than disposable or dataset cardinalities other than the seeded synthetic contract.

Evidence files contain only protocol dimensions, monotonic timestamps, outcome, retry count, database duration and stable error codes. Payloads, callback data, customer identities, row values and row hashes stay in private /tmp state and are never printed or retained.
Ingress payloads, control tokens and the webhook secret are held in memory only; the secret is derived from the admitted candidate settings and is never written to evidence.
No shell interpolation is used for Docker or probe subprocesses; arguments are lists, child stderr is discarded and unexpected exceptions emit only a stable error code.

Candidate cells cannot reach money, stock, order, payment, credential, outbound-effect or supplier writers: the navigation grant envelope is applied, the payment/receipt workers are not started, and every batch is followed by a full public-table row hash comparison that fails the run on any change.
The benchmark adds no production route, webhook change, scheduler, credential, provider call, customer message or CI workflow.
The paired report refuses mismatched protocol, dataset checksums, PostgreSQL settings or limits, and a missing authority audit can never produce a continue recommendation.

residual_risks.text: The probe-sized WSGI accept backlog is 64 instead of serve.py's 8 so synchronized client waves measure the request path rather than a harness socket limit. This is a probe configuration, not a candidate capacity claim.

Instrumentation wraps candidate classes inside the probe process tree (execute_wrapper plus processor/transport wrappers). A future rename fails the probe loudly with a stable error code; it cannot silently alter product behaviour.
Candidate evidence covers navigation only. Orders, Balance and all payment stages remain unmeasured because the candidate surface does not exist.

A stale wakeup can re-enter the processor after the sweep already rendered the row; the terminal outcome was briefly recorded as duplicate. Reproduction showed applied/duplicate only and no handler exception. The probe now keeps the first terminal outcome; the completed run retains the 15 recorded errors and their cells stay inconclusive.
